ash_1.said: An orc's letter home: "Dear Mum, the ash is lovely. I've eaten nothing that talked. Mostly."

ash_2.said: A slate by the bedrolls: "Quiet after dark. This means you, Brog."

ash_3.said: An orc's shopping list: "Meat. More meat. Something green, for Mum."

ash_4.said: A note nailed to the tent post, in a very tired hand: "Please stop eating the tent."

forest_1.said: A diary, a little damp: "Day 40. Still a slime. Still happy."

forest_2.said: A goblin's love letter, never sent: "Your warts are like stars. I counted. Forty-one."

forest_3.said: A wolf's stash: three bones, sorted by size. The biggest one has a name.

marsh_1.said: A skeleton's letter home: "Mum, the marsh is lovely. Bit damp in the ribs."

marsh_2.said: A note in very faint ink: "Gone out. Back in a century."

marsh_3.said: A wolf's stash: a stick, a better stick, and a third stick nobody may touch.

deep_1.said: A troll's diary: "Ate a bridge today. Turns out you're meant to live under it."

deep_2.said: A bedtime story chalked on bark: "...and the troll ate the knight. The end." Well thumbed.

deep_3.said: A troll's recipe: "Stone soup. Step one: stone." There is no step two.

deep_4.said: Orders cut into a slab: "Guard the thing." Nobody said which thing. It guarded all of them.

mire_1.said: A ghost's love letter: "I would give you my heart, but I can't think where I left it."

mire_2.said: The skeletons' rota, very tidy: "Mon: rattle. Tue: rattle. Wed: Gerald (Gerald, it IS your turn)."

mire_3.said: A notice under a stone, so it won't drift off: "Boo practice, Tuesdays. Bring your own chains."

mire_4.said: A skeleton's drawing of himself, with muscles. Optimistic, and rather good.

coast_1.said: The crabs' collection: a fork, two buttons and one very shiny spoon, in a row.

coast_2.said: A pirate's map. X marks the spot. The spot is this tent. He was bad at hiding things.

coast_3.said: Shells sorted by size, then by how much somebody liked them.

coast_4.said: A gunner's letter: "Dear Mum. Still deaf. Still happy. Send socks."

coast_captain.said: The captain's log: "Crew asked for shore leave. Told them we ARE ashore. Mutiny pending."

mines_1.said: A goblin's shift log: "Dug. Dug more. Found a rock. Put it back."

mines_2.said: The goblins' suggestion box. One suggestion, in big letters: "LESS ROCKS."

mines_3.said: A spear-goblin's list of things to do: "Poke things." Ticked off twice.

greyhold_1.said: A bandit's cheese ledger: "Stolen: 9 wheels. Eaten: 9 wheels. Profit: none, but worth it."

greyhold_2.said: A bowman's scorecard: three bullseyes, eleven trees, one very surprised goose.

greyhold_3.said: Half a knitted scarf, and a note: "For Mum. Do NOT stab."

greyhold_4.said: A coat turned inside out, a note pinned on: "Wash me. I've changed sides twice this week."

greyhold_5.said: A sign-up sheet: "Join the turncoats! Nice coats, no loyalty needed." Both names crossed out.

frost_1.said: The wolves' winter store: one frozen sausage, guarded like a crown.

frost_2.said: Under the snow by the tent: one mitten. The wolves are very proud of it.

frost_3.said: A yeti's diary: "Saw a man. He screamed. I screamed. We both ran. Nice day."

frost_4.said: A note in a wendigo's scrawl: "Hungry." Below, smaller: "Also a bit lonely."

road_1.said: The hounds' stash: a shepherd's crook, chewed into a much better shape.

road_2.said: A wyvern's nest, and an egg somebody painted a smile on. You leave it be.

road_3.said: The hounds' hoard: one old boot, chewed with love. They will want it back.
